title: Managing simultaneous CMV and BK viremia
prompt: Kidney SOT (D+/R−) on tac/MMF/pred: CMV 5.0 log10 IU/mL and BK 3.5 log10 copies/mL. How do we adjust immunosuppression to control both without triggering rejection? Discuss sequential vs simultaneous reduction strategies and antiviral choices (valganciclovir vs letermovir).

title: Donor-derived early fungal infection in xenotransplant
prompt: Pig-to-human kidney xenotransplant, day 10: fevers + pulmonary nodules. Cultures: Candida parapsilosis; donor perfusate PCR positive for fungal DNA. How to differentiate donor-derived infection from contamination? What diagnostics (histopath, WGS confirmation) and antifungal strategy are supported?

title: CR-Pseudomonas sepsis on ECMO
prompt: Liver SOT on VV-ECMO for ARDS now has carbapenem-resistant Pseudomonas septic shock. What are evidence-based options (e.g., ceftolozane/tazobactam, cefiderocol, combos)? Include ECMO dosing considerations and CNI nephrotoxicity risks.

title: Polyviral reactivation on belatacept
prompt: Kidney SOT on belatacept+MMF: fever + pancytopenia. PCR: EBV 4.3 log, CMV 3.7 log, HHV-6 2.8 log. How to interpret polyviral reactivation? Which virus likely drives cytopenia? Outline diagnostics and management (BM biopsy, MMF hold, IS conversion).

title: Nocardia vs TB diagnostic conflict
prompt: Heart SOT, chronic cough, nodular lung lesions. AFB smears positive, MTB PCR negative; cultures later grow Nocardia farcinica. Explain differences between Nocardia and TB in transplant hosts, how to interpret discordant smear/PCR, and outline therapy incl. CNS prophylaxis.

title: Endemic mycosis after travel
prompt: Kidney SOT returns from Arizona with fever/cough. BAL serology positive for Coccidioides, culture negative. Management choice (fluconazole vs amphotericin), duration, and when to resume full IS?

title: Adenovirus viremia with graft dysfunction (peds)
prompt: Pediatric kidney SOT, 2 months post-tx: rising creatinine, hemorrhagic cystitis, adenovirus PCR 4.0 log. Pathophysiology of adenoviral nephritis, role of cidofovir/brincidofovir, renal-protective strategies, and thresholds to reduce CNIs.

title: Mixed infections after anti-rejection therapy
prompt: After methylpred + thymoglobulin, kidney SOT develops fever, diarrhea, rash. Tests: C. difficile+, Norovirus+, CMV 2.8 log. Prioritize management: infection control, antiviral therapy, microbiota protection, safe IS taper.

title: PERV detection after xenotransplant
prompt: Xenotransplant recipient with low-level PERV-A/C qPCR in PBMCs (not plasma). Interpret as contamination vs transient donor DNA vs infection. Outline confirmatory testing (integration assays, RNA seq), biosafety, and reporting.

title: PML after kidney transplant
prompt: Kidney SOT on tac/MMF with subacute confusion and white-matter lesions; CSF JCV PCR positive. Management principles (IS reduction, mirtazapine/IVIG/pembrolizumab), expected recovery, and recurrence risk.
